newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bre-X Busang gold permit unlikely soon - sources.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X Busang gold permit unlikely soon - sources.

text.p: Canada's Bre-X Minerals Ltd is unlikely to get contracts of work soon to develop its Indonesian gold property due to the complexity of a dispute surrounding its claim, official Indonesian sources said on Friday.
"It's a very complex situation and is unlikely to be resolved soon," a senior source said.

Bre-X, which says its Busang find in East Kalimantan contains at least 47 million ounces of gold, is locked in a dispute with Indonesian businessman Jusuf Merukh over rights to the property, one of the world's richest gold discoveries.

Indonesia's Director-General of Mining Kuntoro Mangkusubroto said on Thursday the government would withhold contracts of work sought by Bre-X for Busang until it had resolved its dispute with its local partner.

Merukh says he has a 20 percent interest through two of his companies in the Busang I area of the property, and is claiming up to 40 percent in the adjacent Busang II and III areas which contain the bulk of the ore.
